selection: Same named country subset as the old test topic; not all countries or a refreshed top-20 ranking.
emissions_scope: Production/territorial fossil-fuel and industrial CO2, excluding land-use change; see pinned codebook.
cumulative: Upstream cumulative values from the first available source year, not the sum of the 2000-2022 excerpt.
global_share: Source-reported global denominator. World rows are provided separately and are not additional countries.
missing: Empty CSV fields mean unavailable, not zero.
components: Coal, oil, gas, cement, flaring, other industry. Verify available components and source rounding before drawing complete compositions.
revision: Re-extracted from pinned OWID commit; use these values consistently instead of mixing old fixture numbers.
